# Freetip

> Freetip lets Indian YouTube streamers take tips from fans by UPI or card. Fans need no account and no email. Streamers get a short link, OBS alerts and text-to-speech.

## Pages

- [Home](https://freetip.in/): what Freetip is and how it works
- [Pricing](https://freetip.in/pricing): the 5% fee and the flat 2.75% processing charge
- [About](https://freetip.in/about): who runs Freetip
- [Contact](https://freetip.in/contact): the contact form and grievance details
